decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system is tightly connected to our established coolant-management knowledge and service capabilities, and its survival after launch suggests we can keep refining it through customer feedback and in-house R&D rather than withdraw it.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge builds directly on our filtration and process-media expertise, so our strong absorptive capacity and research base make continued improvement and retention more likely than exit.
The coolant nozzles line is a highly related modular complement to our coolant systems, and as a multi-model range it can be adapted efficiently within our existing engineering and sales structure.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is somewhat less central than our coolant products but still close to our conveying and automation competences, so we are likely to keep it while monitoring its fit and performance.

The magnetic belt chip conveyor fits well with our existing chip-handling and conveying know-how, and our engineering depth and installed customer base support further commercialization rather than discontinuation.
